calls.statement:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6
),
cur AS (SELECT sku, category AS cur_cat FROM dim_product WHERE is_current),
lines AS (
  SELECT 'sale' AS kind, p.sku, p.category AS asof_cat, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS cst
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'return', p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1 AND s.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT 'restated' AS basis, c.cur_cat AS category, round(sum(net),2) AS net_sales, round(sum(cst),2) AS std_cost, round(100*(sum(net)-sum(cst))/sum(net),2) AS gm_pct, round(sum(case when kind='sale' then net end),2) AS before_returns
FROM lines l JOIN cur c USING (sku) WHERE c.cur_cat IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'as_was', asof_cat, round(sum(net),2), round(sum(cst),2), round(100*(sum(net)-sum(cst))/sum(net),2), round(sum(case when kind='sale' then net end),2)
FROM lines WHERE asof_cat IN ('Garden','Electrical') GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2
